source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Project Planning and Management (PDF 16).

blocks.text: Software project ki mansooba bandi safar ki mansooba bandi jaisi hai: aap ko jaanna chahiye ke kahan ja rahe hain, kitna waqt lagega aur kitna kharcha hoga. Project planning aur management mein project management plan ke paanch marahil, jame mansooba bandi, waqt ki hadein (timelines), laagat ka andaza, khatron ka intezam aur quality assurance shamil hain.

blocks.prompt: Software project ki planning ko safar ki planning se kyun milaya gaya hai?
blocks.explanation: Dono mein rawangi se pehle wazeh manzil (maqsad), waqt ka andaza (timeline) aur kharche ka andaza (budget) chahiye.

items: Project planning aur management: shuru se pehle maqsad, waqt aur kharcha jaanna, safar ki planning ki tarah.
Is mein PM ke paanch marahil, planning, timelines, laagat ka andaza, khatron ka intezam aur quality assurance.
